verses.en: Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
verses.pt: Ouve, SENHOR, a minha justiça; presta atenção ao meu choro, dá ouvidos à minha oração de lábios que não enganam.
verses.en_web: Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea; Give ear to my prayer, that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
verses.en_bbe: <A Prayer. Of David.> Let my cause come to your ears, O Lord, give attention to my cry; give ear to my prayer which goes not out from false lips.

verses.en: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
verses.pt: De diante de teu rosto saia o meu julgamento; teus olhos observarão o que é justo.
verses.en_web: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.
verses.en_bbe: Be my judge; for your eyes see what is right.

verses.en: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
verses.pt: Tu já provaste o meu coração, tu me visitaste de noite; tu me investigaste, e nada achaste; decidi que minha boca não transgredirá.
verses.en_web: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.
verses.en_bbe: You have put my heart to the test, searching me in the night; you have put me to the test and seen no evil purpose in me; I will keep my mouth from sin.

verses.en: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
verses.pt: Quanto às obras dos homens, conforme a palavra de teus lábios eu me guardei dos caminhos do violento;
verses.en_web: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
verses.en_bbe: As for the works of men, by the word of your lips I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

verses.en: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.
verses.pt: Guiando meu andar em teus caminhos, para que meus passos não tropecem.
verses.en_web: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
verses.en_bbe: I have kept my feet in your ways, my steps have not been turned away.

verses.en: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
verses.pt: Eu clamo a ti, ó Deus, porque tu me respondes; inclina teus ouvidos a mim, escuta a minha palavra.
verses.en_web: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
verses.en_bbe: My cry has gone up to you, for you will give me an answer, O God: let your ear be turned to me, and give attention to my words.

verses.en: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.
verses.pt: Revela maravilhosamente tuas misericórdias, tu salvas aos que confiam em ti com tua mão direita daqueles se se levantam contra ti.
verses.en_web: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
verses.en_bbe: Make clear the wonder of your mercy, O saviour of those who put their faith in your right hand, from those who come out against them.

verses.en: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
verses.pt: Guarda-me como a pupila do olho; esconde-me debaixo da sombra de tuas asas,
verses.en_web: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
verses.en_bbe: Keep me as the light of your eyes, covering me with the shade of your wings,

verses.en: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
verses.pt: De diante dos perversos que me oprimem; dos meus mortais inimigos que me cercam.
verses.en_web: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
verses.en_bbe: From the evil-doers who are violent to me, and from those who are round me, desiring my death.

verses.en: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.pt: Eles se enchem de gordura; com sua boca falam arrogantemente.
verses.en_web: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.en_bbe: They are shut up in their fat: with their mouths they say words of pride.

verses.en: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
verses.pt: Agora eles têm nos cercado em nossos passos; eles fixam seus olhos para nos derrubar ao chão.
verses.en_web: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
verses.en_bbe: They have made a circle round our steps: their eyes are fixed on us, forcing us down to the earth;

verses.en: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.pt: Semelhantes ao leão, que deseja nos despedaçar, e ao leãozinho, que fica em esconderijos.
verses.en_web: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.en_bbe: Like a lion desiring its food, and like a young lion waiting in secret places.

verses.en: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:
verses.pt: Levanta-te, SENHOR, confronta-o, derruba-o; livra minha alma d as mãos do perverso com tua espada.
verses.en_web: Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword;
verses.en_bbe: Up! Lord, come out against him, make him low, with your sword be my saviour from the evil-doer.

verses.en: From men which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
verses.pt: Dos homens com tua mão, SENHOR, dos homens que são do mundo, cuja parte está n esta vida, cujo ventre enches de teu secreto tesouro; os filhos se fartam, e deixam sua sobra para suas crianças.
verses.en_web: from men by your hand, Yahweh, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.
verses.en_bbe: With your hand, O Lord, from men, even men of the world, whose heritage is in this life, and whom you make full with your secret wealth: they are full of children; after their death their offspring take the rest of their goods.

verses.en: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
verses.pt: Mas eu olharei para teu rosto em justiça; serei satisfeito de tua semelhança, quando eu despertar. Para o regente. Do servo do SENHOR, chamado Davi, o qual falou as palavras deste cântico ao SENHOR, no dia em que o SENHOR o livrou das mãos de todos os seus inimigos, e das mãos de Saul. Ele disse:
verses.en_web: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
verses.en_bbe: As for me, I will see your face in righteousness: when I am awake it will be joy enough for me to see your form.
